name: io.github.sidinsearch/bugproof
title: BugProof
description: Capture, replay, and debug failures with portable, executable bug artifacts

tools.name: capture
tools.description: Run a command and capture its output as a .bug artifact

tools.name: replay
tools.description: Replay a .bug file and return the reproduction verdict

tools.name: inspect
tools.description: Show metadata for a .bug artifact without replaying

tools.name: diff
tools.description: Compare two .bug artifacts to find differences

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Check if bugproof sandbox capabilities are available
